title: This World Sunscreen Day, we wanted to make UV protection visible. 🔍
caption:
This World Sunscreen Day, we wanted to make UV protection visible. 🔍

So, we took sunscreen awareness to urban hotspots with UV cameras and SPF Checkpoints, where our UV Bouncers helped people see how sunscreen forms a protective layer on the skin and helps protect it from sun damage.🌞🫧

The reactions said it all.

At Deconstruct, we believe consumer education works best when it is simple, science-backed, and experienced in real time.🔬

Because UV protection should not just be understood. It should be seen.🕵🏻
